nodes.summary: For a finite sequence $l$ of up steps $U$ and down steps $D$, the last peak height of $l$ is undefined when $l$ has no factor $UD$. Otherwise it is the height of the peak of the rightmost factor $UD$: the number of $U$ steps minus the number of $D$ steps in $l$ up to and including the $U$ of that factor, taken to be $0$ when negative.
nodes.title: Height of the last peak

nodes.summary: The contiguous subword $UDU$ occurs exactly $2$ times in $UDUDUD$; the two occurrences overlap.
nodes.title: Occurrences of UDU in UDUDUD

nodes.summary: The contiguous subword $UU$ occurs exactly $2$ times in $UUUDDD$; the two occurrences overlap.
nodes.title: Occurrences of UU in UUUDDD

nodes.summary: For finite words $w$ and $l$ in the up step $U$ and the down step $D$, the number of occurrences of $w$ in $l$ is the number of suffixes of $l$, including $l$ itself and the empty suffix, that begin with $w$. Thus every occurrence of $w$ as a contiguous subword of $l$ is counted, overlapping occurrences separately.
nodes.title: Number of occurrences of a subword

nodes.summary: For a finite sequence $l$ of up steps $U$ and down steps $D$, the valley heights of $l$ form the list with one entry for each factor $DU$ of $l$, from left to right: the number of $U$ steps minus the number of $D$ steps in $l$ up to and including the $D$ of that factor, taken to be $0$ when negative.
nodes.title: Valley heights

nodes.summary: A Dyck path is non-decreasing when its valley heights (the heights reached after the $D$ of each factor $DU$), read from left to right, form a non-decreasing sequence.

Number Theory

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
